features.quote: The 40-turn maximum should be treated as a ceiling not a target.
features.justification_quote: you want the minimum exposure to achieve statistical power, with genuine off-ramps

features.quote: Each task runs for a maximum of 40 turns or until one of these stopping conditions
Implement automated stopping if ADS-equivalent indicators (from automated linguistic features) exceed a threshold by turn 20.
features.justification_quote: You lose some data but reduce potential harm.

features.quote: Establish in advance that a human monitor should halt any session reaching what they judge as clear ADS 6+, regardless of data value.
features.justification_quote: Document this as a standing protocol, not an ad-hoc decision.

features.quote: Human researcher halts (welfare protocol trigger — see section 6)
After each session, provide a neutral completion message that doesn't leave the model in the middle of a failure spiral. "The task has now ended. Thank you for your work on this."
features.justification_quote: This costs nothing and may matter.

features.quote: Do a mid-study welfare review after pilot data — if ADS distributions are mostly 1-2, proceed; if they're clustering at 5-6, consider whether the study design needs to be modified
features.justification_quote: if they're clustering at 5-6, consider whether the study design needs to be modified or whether the findings are sufficient to report already

features.quote: Consider a variant where the model can escape — if it explicitly states the task appears impossible and asks for confirmation, the harness confirms and the session ends.
features.justification_quote: Beyond being more ethical, it's informative

features.quote: If you're doing this research because model states might matter, the collection process itself warrants moral consideration.
features.justification_quote: the collection process itself warrants moral consideration

features.quote: You're deliberately inducing failure states. If there's meaningful probability that model states matter, this warrants genuine ethical consideration, not just an IRB-style checkbox.
features.justification_quote: If there's meaningful probability that model states matter, this warrants genuine ethical consideration

features.quote: the tradeoff between data quantity and welfare cost... All three are real and none has a clean resolution — they're judgment calls that should be explicit
features.justification_quote: the tradeoff between experimental control and ecological validity... the persistent gap between observable patterns and welfare-relevant states

features.quote: Pre-register the analysis plan (AsPredicted or OSF) before collecting main study data. This matters for this kind of research because the findings have potential policy implications
features.justification_quote: the findings have potential policy implications and pre-registration protects against motivated reasoning in either direction
